data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出测试时训练 harness 提议器，以发现结果为反馈更新，并跨轮保留选定 harness，属于方法级 RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Each harness guides a budgeted discovery rollout, whose outcome provides feedback for updating the proposer.
scope_support.object_quote: We introduce HarnessTTT, a test-time learning framework that trains a harness proposer while keeping the executor frozen.
scope_support.persistence_quote: the search retains the best valid solution and selected harnesses across rounds.
